Reports indicate that columns of smoke are rising from the Jizan oil refinery in Saudi Arabia following an apparent drone and/or missile strike by Ansar Allah.

According to reports from Ukrainian monitoring channels, the Russian Armed Forces are preparing for a large-scale combined strike against targets across Ukraine.
The strike could involve up to 60 air-launched Kh-101 cruise missiles, around 30 Iskander-M and KN-23 ballistic missiles, as well as 3M22 Zircon hypersonic missiles, not including ballistic missiles based on the modified RM-48U.
Jet-powered loitering munitions are also expected to be used in the strikes.
As for the timing, the strike is highly likely to be carried out in the coming days. It is also possible that it could take place tonight, following a brief ban on strikes against targets in Kyiv.
